description.value: Walmart Supercentre at 3585 Grandview Highway is a large-format big-box grocery and general merchandise store in East Vancouver. As a Supercentre format, it carries a full grocery department alongside apparel, electronics, home goods, and seasonal merchandise. For touring cyclists, it represents one of the most comprehensive one-stop restocking points in the area.

The website front page confirms it is Store 1104 and lists grocery, electronics, toys, clothing, furniture, and baby departments, corroborating the grocery category.
